scenes.title: Four little boxes
scenes.caption: A buffer is a fixed region of memory.
scenes.narration: This is a buffer. It has room for four bytes.

scenes.title: Three letters fit
scenes.caption: CAT + NUL = 4 bytes
scenes.narration: Copy three ASCII letters and the zero byte that ends the string. All four fit.

scenes.title: One extra letter
scenes.caption: CATS + NUL = 5 bytes
scenes.narration: Add one letter. Without a size check, the terminating zero is now outside the buffer.

scenes.title: Keep writing?
scenes.caption: Writing outside the buffer is undefined behavior.
scenes.narration: An unchecked copy can corrupt other data or crash. This is a simplified picture, not a guaranteed memory layout.

scenes.title: Check before copying
scenes.caption: Allow at most 3 ASCII characters plus NUL.
scenes.narration: Check the length against capacity, including the terminator. Reject input that cannot fit.

scenes.title: Buffer overflow
scenes.caption: You just learned how a buffer overflow works.
scenes.narration: Congratulations. You just learned how a buffer overflow works.
